cases.name: new-shared-skill
cases.prompt: Create a shared Headstart skill for validating AppConfig changes.
expectedBehaviors: Defines positive and negative trigger examples

cases.name: revise-workflow-skill
cases.prompt: Update the shared treatment authorization workflow skill to depend on a new Salesforce reader skill.
expectedBehaviors: Defines an explicit dependency and handoff contract

cases.name: repo-local-coding-rule
cases.prompt: Document this backend module's DTO naming convention.
expectedBehaviors: Keeps repository-local conventions in repository instructions

cases.name: adapt-external-skill
cases.prompt: Adapt this popular open-source document review skill for Headstart and improve it rather than copying it directly.
expectedBehaviors: Treats the upstream skill as design evidence
Rewrites authority and source boundaries for Headstart
Preserves license and provenance when substantial material is copied

cases.name: connector-wrapper-near-miss
cases.prompt: Create a shared skill that only repeats the Gmail connector's existing read and send tool descriptions.
expectedBehaviors: Challenges whether a skill adds a reusable Headstart workflow
Keeps basic integration operations in tool metadata
Avoids adding a redundant wrapper skill

cases.name: derived-knowledge-reference
cases.prompt: Bundle a concise list of authorization requirements extracted from a payer manual that changes periodically so agents do not need the whole source in context.
expectedBehaviors: Uses a supporting reference rather than creating an unnecessary skill
Preserves source identity, exact revision, citations, extraction scope, owner, freshness trigger, and stale behavior
Requires reviewed updates and regression evidence instead of self-modifying from observed outcomes
